Title: Integrity and Ethical Values
Description: Management demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values.

Title: Board Oversight
Description: The board of directors exercises oversight responsibility for system security and compliance.

Title: Organizational Structure
Description: Management establishes structure, authority, and responsibility for internal controls.

Title: Commitment to Competence
Description: Organization attracts, develops, and retains competent individuals.

Title: Accountability
Description: Individuals are held accountable for internal control responsibilities.

Title: Communication of Objectives
Description: Management communicates internal control objectives to relevant parties.

Title: Internal Communication
Description: Organization internally communicates roles, policies, and procedures.

Title: External Communication
Description: Organization communicates with external parties regarding incidents and compliance.

Title: Risk Identification
Description: Organization identifies and assesses risks to the achievement of objectives.

Title: Risk Analysis
Description: Analyzes risks as a basis for determining control activities.

Title: Risk Response
Description: Develops responses to identified risks.

Title: Change Identification
Description: Identifies and assesses changes that could impact internal controls.

Title: Monitoring
Description: Selects, develops, and performs ongoing or separate evaluations.

Title: Evaluation of Deficiencies
Description: Evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies timely.

Title: Control Activities
Description: Selects and develops control activities that mitigate risks.

Title: Technology Controls
Description: Selects and develops general control activities over technology.

Title: Policies and Procedures
Description: Deploys control activities through formal policies and procedures.

Title: Logical Access
Description: Implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and procedures.

Title: User Authentication
Description: Implements authentication mechanisms for authorized access.

Title: User Access Provisioning
Description: Authorizes, modifies, and removes access appropriately.

Title: Physical Access
Description: Restricts physical access to systems and data centers.

Title: Network Security
Description: Prevents and detects unauthorized network access.

Title: Access Revocation
Description: Removes access in a timely manner upon termination.

Title: Encryption and Data Protection
Description: Protects data through encryption or other means during transmission and storage.

Title: Operational Monitoring
Description: Monitors system components and operations to detect anomalies.

Title: Incident Detection
Description: Detects and analyzes security incidents in a timely manner.

Title: Incident Response
Description: Responds to and mitigates the impact of identified incidents.

Title: Incident Post-Mortem
Description: Documents root cause and lessons learned following incidents.

Title: Change Management
Description: Authorizes, tests, and documents changes to systems and software.

Title: Change Monitoring
Description: Reviews emergency changes and configuration updates.

Title: Vendor Risk Management
Description: Selects and monitors vendors and third parties affecting system security.

Title: Vendor Contracting
Description: Includes security and compliance requirements in vendor agreements.

Title: Risk Mitigation
Description: Implements control activities to mitigate risks from third-party relationships.

Title: Backup and Recovery
Description: Implements procedures for data backup and system recovery.

Title: Availability Monitoring
Description: Monitors system availability and performance commitments.

Title: Disaster Recovery Testing
Description: Tests recovery procedures periodically and documents results.

Title: Confidentiality Classification
Description: Identifies and classifies confidential information.

Title: Confidentiality Protection
Description: Implements controls to protect confidential information from unauthorized access.

Title: Confidentiality Disposal
Description: Ensures proper disposal of confidential data after retention period.

Title: Processing Authorization
Description: Ensures only authorized data is processed.

Title: Processing Accuracy
Description: Implements controls to maintain accuracy and completeness of system processing.

Title: Processing Timeliness
Description: Ensures data is processed and delivered on time.

Title: Processing Error Handling
Description: Detects and corrects processing errors effectively.

Title: Notice and Consent
Description: Provides notice and obtains consent regarding personal data collection and use.

Title: Data Retention
Description: Retains personal data only as long as necessary for business or legal purposes.

Title: Data Access and Correction
Description: Provides individuals the ability to access and correct their personal data.

Title: Data Disclosure
Description: Discloses personal data only for authorized purposes.

Title: Breach Notification
Description: Notifies affected parties and regulators in case of data breaches.
